ns2:course.label: Hospitalized Children
ns2:course.description: Examines the developmental needs and stress reactions of children and families in a hospital/medical setting; examines responses of family and staff facing terminal illness and the death of a family member; familiarizes students with general hospital procedures, medical terms, and illnesses; introduces the role of Child Life programs and the Child Life Specialist. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: HDFS 105 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: HDFS 105 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing. Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
